scope: Plan one July-trained local LAD model and one August development screen; this change executes only hash/timestamp/identifier preflight and synthetic tests.
authorization: User requested the one-hour Owasco oxygen protocol: July training, August development, MAE primary. Environmental fitting/scoring is a later task, not performed by this change.

candidate.target: delta = saved actual O(t+1h) minus saved persistence P=O(t), binary64 subtraction
candidate.prediction: L=P+deltaHat; deltaHat=math.fsum([intercept]+[coefficient[j]*z[j] in frozen feature order]); no final rounding
candidate.kind: Linear conditional-median (quantile 0.5 / least absolute deviations), free intercept, eight features, uniform row weights
candidate.regularization: None: no L1/L2 coefficient penalty. Not median(absolute errors).

preprocessing.source: All and only the 1275 bound July rows, archived chronological order
preprocessing.transform: (x_j-mean_j)/scale_j in binary64; never center or scale on August
preprocessing.zeroVariance: If variance equals exactly 0: save scale=1 and constant mask=true; transformed column=0 for both months and coefficient bound=(0,0). No near-zero cutoff.
preprocessing.invalid: Nonfinite features/target/scaler or inconsistent source lineage stops entire run; no dropped rows, imputation, interpolation or changed eligibility.

optimizer.environmentPolicy: Before the later fit, record interpreter, OS, architecture, installed distribution/wheel/source hashes and bundled HiGHS version. Mismatch requires a protocol amendment before any environmental fit, never a solver swap after scoring.
optimizer.variables: theta=(intercept,beta[0..7]) then u[0..N-1]; rows July chronological, columns frozen feature order
optimizer.lp: A=[ones,Z]; A_ub=[[A,-I],[-A,-I]]; b_ub=[delta,-delta]; c=[0]*9+[1/N]*N; no equalities
optimizer.bounds: All 9 theta variables (None,None), except beta of exactly constant features (0,0); all N u variables (0,None). Explicit bounds: linprog default nonnegative coefficients are forbidden.
optimizer.failure: Any warning about unused options, unsuccessful status, numerical failure or acceptance-check failure stops. No alternate solver, retry-to-pick-weights, penalty or hyperparameter scan.
optimizer.multipleOptima: Plain LAD need not have unique coefficients. Fixed procedure/environment yields one solution; frozen scaler/weights bytes are canonical. No promise of cross-platform bit-identical refitting, minimum-norm selection or unique physical explanation.

acceptance.require: success is True, status==0; all coefficients/slacks finite; recompute residuals and constraint violations from July only
acceptance.trainingSanity: Training MAE(L)<=training MAE(P)+1e-7 mg/L because zero delta is feasible; this is an optimizer check, not validation
acceptance.meaning: Numerical tolerances only; no ecological or sensor-accuracy interpretation

candidate.comparisonMeaning: New local training and new loss are changed together. A result cannot isolate which change caused any gain.

developmentDecision.metric: MAE = math.fsum(abs(prediction-actual) for all 1306 August rows)/1306
developmentDecision.baseline: Exact saved persistence P=O(t); same rows and archived targets
developmentDecision.pass: All 1306 predictions finite and nonnegative AND gain>1e-9 mg/L
developmentDecision.invalid: Any negative/nonfinite L prevents success. Keep full denominator and record invalid row IDs; uncomputable primary score=null, never average only valid rows or replace by P.
developmentDecision.ifFailOrTie: STOP this candidate and discuss the next design. No retry, threshold, alternative month, parameter search, September or promotion.
developmentDecision.ifPass: Development gain only. Discuss a separately preregistered unopened verification before any environmental/operational claim.
developmentDecision.julyRole: Training only; no July out-of-sample success gate. Previous two-month rule belongs to the prior frozen candidates and remains unchanged in their evidence.
developmentDecision.noMinimumPercentageClaim: No adopted 10% success threshold. The numerical gate is not statistical significance or practical utility.

plannedReporting.rowEvidence: For every fixed row: origin,target,source index, actual,P,L,deltaHat,errors,gain and validity; bind scaler/weight/source/protocol hashes.
plannedReporting.primary: One full-cohort August MAE vs P, N=1306, invalid count and gain
secondary: August max absolute error and signed mean error
Every UTC day MAE and gain, no chosen favorable days
August counts and summed gains for helps/ties/harms vs P using fixed 1e-9 mg/L tie tolerance
Changed-prediction count using exact L!=P, distinct from helps/harms
Descriptive saved old-R comparison only, not an alternative primary baseline
plannedReporting.examples: First chronological helps and harms cases, selected only after routing for explanation; no new trigger or tuning from examples
plannedReporting.recomposition: Every partition count/error/gain sum must reconstruct the complete monthly cohort within fixed 1e-9 mg/L mean-error tolerance
plannedReporting.uncertainty: No new p-value/bootstrap to rescue this development screen. Correlated overlapping origins are not independent events; future unopened verification requires an uncertainty plan fixed before acquisition.

preflight.allowedFields: Top-level station/window/horizon, row origin/target, oxygenHistory.timeUTC and evidence observation UUIDs. Do not access actual, features, history values or predictions.
preflight.scopeLimit: Checks archive separation/integrity, not future training-code behavior, physical accuracy, temperature chronology independently or as-of-origin availability.

stages: NOW: write/review protocol; hash-bound metadata-only preflight and synthetic tests. No fit, preprocessing statistics or new environmental predictions/scores.

LATER, after a new instruction to execute: implement July-only fit and separate prediction/score paths; pass synthetic, leakage and optimizer tests; commit/push implementation and exact recipe BEFORE environmental fit.

Run one July-only fit, archive complete scaler/weights, mask, diagnostics, environment, source/protocol/code hashes, times and stdout. Freeze/push immutable model artifact BEFORE any August candidate prediction.
Run one August development score with frozen artifact; retain output, invalid records, all rows and success/failure. Subsequent verify is read-only replay, never refit.
Discuss result with user; no automatic new candidate, unopened data, merge or operational promotion.
limitations: Both July and August archives were already opened during earlier experiments; August is development, not blind/independent validation.
Finalized USGS 2020 records from one near-surface site do not establish real-time availability, whole-lake forecasts or ecological causes.
Published decimal resolution is not sensor accuracy; repeated values do not prove physical stability.
No September access or new observations. No changes to existing frozen Willamette ridge, historical reports, Oracle, blockchain, consensus, governance, community rights or funds.
mission: Virdacora, formerly TerraVoce: understandable, verifiable environmental evidence serving affected communities; numerical forecast research only, with LLM commentary outside operational consensus.
